intended_runtime_use: help the incident assistant generate concise first messages
support deterministic spatial reasoning before LLM summarization

camera_context.camera_mount_description: User-provided: mounted on the roof of Thunder Valley Casino Resort.
camera_context.view_direction_description: User-provided: looking north toward Lincoln Crossing.

primary_site_context.name: Thunder Valley Casino Resort
primary_site_context.operational_relevance: If smoke/fire moves toward the resort or visible parking/venue areas, treat as potentially high operational sensitivity.

farm_owner_site.name: Farm owner site
farm_owner_site.operational_relevance: If a detection is close to this site or moving toward it, the assistant may suggest preparing a property-owner/site-operator update, but must not invent a person name or phone number.

nearby_operational_landmarks.name: Lincoln Crossing
known_facts: Community association source says it encompasses over 40 acres and close to 3000 single-family homes.
nearby_operational_landmarks.direction_from_camera: north / northeast in the camera context
nearby_operational_landmarks.recommended_action_hint: If smoke/fire is inside, near, or moving toward Lincoln Crossing, suggest notifying the relevant local authority or local emergency contact.

nearby_operational_landmarks.name: Wetland / slough / ponds northwest of the camera view
known_facts: The provided satellite screenshot shows wetland/water features northwest of the farm-owner site.
The map label 'Ingram Slough' appears in the screenshot, but it should be treated as screenshot-observed unless separately verified.
nearby_operational_landmarks.recommended_action_hint: Fire detected only over water/wetland may be lower priority, but smoke movement toward homes, roads, or structures can still raise priority.

nearby_operational_landmarks.name: Industrial Avenue / Twelve Bridges Drive corridor
known_facts: The City of Lincoln speed ordinance search result identifies Twelve Bridges Drive and Industrial Avenue as local road names.
nearby_operational_landmarks.recommended_action_hint: If smoke/fire threatens road visibility or access/evacuation routes, suggest notifying relevant local authority.

nearby_operational_landmarks.name: Twelve Bridges High School
nearby_operational_landmarks.recommended_action_hint: Use only when projected map location or downwind movement is plausibly toward the school area. If relevant, suggest notifying the school or relevant local authority.

nearby_operational_landmarks.name: Ferrari RCFE / senior care facility
nearby_operational_landmarks.recommended_action_hint: Treat as a sensitive receptor only after verifying relevance to the projected incident area. Do not use any unverified phone/email in live messages.

authorities_and_contacts.name: Emergency services
authorities_and_contacts.usage_rule: For immediate danger to life/property, emergency message can recommend calling 911.

authorities_and_contacts.name: Lincoln Fire Department
authorities_and_contacts.usage_rule: Use as non-emergency fire contact; for active emergency, recommend 911.

authorities_and_contacts.name: Lincoln Police Department
authorities_and_contacts.usage_rule: Use as non-emergency police/local authority contact; for active emergency, recommend 911.

authorities_and_contacts.name: Placer County Office of Emergency Services
authorities_and_contacts.usage_rule: Use for county emergency management context, preparedness/coordination, not as first substitute for 911.

authorities_and_contacts.name: Farm owner / site operator
authorities_and_contacts.usage_rule: Do not invent. If needed, ask the user to provide it or ask whether to search.

authorities_and_contacts.name: Lincoln Crossing association/contact
authorities_and_contacts.usage_rule: Do not invent. If needed, ask the user whether to search/verify the current contact.

first_message_style: do not expose raw reasoning unless asked

risk_rules.effect: raise urgency and suggest relevant local authority/contact

risk_rules.condition: only near water/wetland and moving away from structures

risk_rules.effect: use generic relevant local authority/site operator, or ask whether to search

incident_reasoning_policy.uncertainty_rule: All map/geolocation outputs are approximate. Never claim exact physical spread prediction.

recommended_first_message_examples: ThunderValleyWest detected smoke near Lincoln Crossing, drifting north. Do you want me to notify the relevant local authority?
Smoke was detected near the farm owner site and appears to be moving toward Lincoln Crossing. Should I prepare a response update?
Possible fire detected near the wetland area. It appears lower priority unless it spreads toward nearby structures. Should I keep monitoring?
Smoke was detected outside the marked zones, but near a sensitive area and moving in that direction. Should I notify the relevant local authority?

implementation_notes.preferred_loading: Load this JSON as optional operational context in the Live Ops incident context builder.
implementation_notes.fallback_behavior: If missing, continue using live_ops_camera.json, zones, reference points, and weather only.
implementation_notes.separate_markdown_context: A companion Markdown file can be used as human-readable/LLM-readable context, but deterministic code should read this JSON.
